description: What the New Jersey Treasury Ineligible Provider List (Medical) data covers and how current it is: total rows ever recorded, how many are currently excluded vs. ended vs. status-unknown, how many carry an NPI or Vendor ID, the distinct action types (Debarment/Suspension/Disqualification), and the oldest/newest exclusion effective dates. Use to check the screening data is fresh enough to rely on before a compliance decision, and to see the one-line notes on the status field's gaps and the ever-vs-currently-excluded distinction. Pass year (e.g. 2025) or start_date/end_date to instead COUNT how many exclusions have an effective date in that year or range, counted over the whole 4,000+ row list, not a page — answers "how many NJ Medicaid exclusions took effect in 2025". The response names the date field counted (effective_date — Treasury's Effective Date). Sourced from the New Jersey Department of the Treasury Ineligible Provider List (Medical), keyless.

end_date.description: Inclusive range end, YYYY-MM-DD. Use with start_date for a custom date range instead of a calendar year.

start_date.description: Inclusive range start, YYYY-MM-DD. Use with end_date for a custom date range instead of a calendar year.

year.description: Count records whose date field falls in this calendar year (e.g. 2025), counted over the WHOLE list, not a page. Ignored if start_date/end_date are given.
